name: components-boundaries
description: The import boundaries AGENTS.md and the package AGENTS.md files state, as policy-violation findings. Relative imports across packages and the charts layering are .fallowrc.json's zones; this pack covers what a zone cannot see: package-name and external specifiers.

rules.message: SvelteKit resolves this only inside an app, and src/lib ships. Take it as a prop or from getComponentsContext().
The form library is an optional peer reached only from the /entity-form entry; importing it anywhere else makes every consumer install it.

Navigation-only menus must not reach bits-ui's menus (~30 KB gzip on every page). The bits-ui parts live in ui/menu-parts/*.svelte, are imported only by ui/DropdownMenu.svelte and ui/ContextMenu.svelte (through menu-parts/parts.ts), and reach the Menu* children through context.
ContextMenu is reached only through its own @thomasfosterau/components/context-menu entry (ui/context-menu.ts), so the root barrel never loads it.
@thomasfosterau/charts is independent of the Svelte packages (packages/charts/AGENTS.md § Boundary).

svelte-package copies src/svelte alone into dist/svelte, so a relative path to spec or core breaks in the published package. Import `@thomasfosterau/charts` or `@thomasfosterau/charts/core` instead (packages/charts/AGENTS.md § Boundary).

The `.` entry of @thomasfosterau/components-import is headless: plain TypeScript over Effect that an app server can import, with no Svelte and none of the other packages. The UI is its own `./svelte` entry, src/svelte (packages/import/AGENTS.md § Boundary).

The `./svelte` entry of @thomasfosterau/components-import reaches the core library through @thomasfosterau/components and effect-document through its root and /schema only: the app passes the formats it accepts, so the entry loads no reader (and no effect-parse) of its own (packages/import/AGENTS.md § Boundary).

@thomasfosterau/effect-document is a required peer of @thomasfosterau/components-import alone (packages/import/AGENTS.md § Boundary); importing it from another package makes every consumer of that package install it.
The Svelte packages do not import @thomasfosterau/charts; the Svelte Chart in /charts is a separate, series-based component.

packages/mapbox consumes the core only through its published /canvas entry (packages/mapbox/AGENTS.md § Boundary). The bare root import is banned by the root vite.config.ts's no-restricted-imports, which can match it exactly.
